status: Closed — complete runner-sync release usage diagnostics and post-close receipt lifecycle verified in source and frozen runner on 2026-09-06
finding: ATM-GOV-0189 dogfood exposed two runner-sync lifecycle frictions: broker runner-sync release reports required arguments one at a time (`--task`, then `--steward-work-id`, then `--receipt-ref`) instead of surfacing the complete first-layer usage contract, and sealed runner build rewrites `.atm/history/evidence/<task>.runner-sync-receipt.json` after taskflow close so a follow-up release-sync commit is blocked by `ATM_PROTECTED_STATE_EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING_TASK_CONTEXT`.
expectedBehavior: Runner-sync release help/error output and first-layer skills should disclose the full required command shape up front. Runner-sync receipts should be either close-owned digest artifacts committed with the task transition, or local runtime/log artifacts with only a stable digest reference in Git; a post-close build should not leave a protected evidence file dirty with no legal commit path.
evidenceOrRepro: Historical reproduction during ATM-GOV-0189 on 2026-07-19: runner-sync release reported required arguments one at a time and a post-close receipt lacked task context. Repaired and reverified on 2026-09-06: `node --strip-types tests/cli/runner-sync-steward-release.test.ts`, `runner-sync-post-close-receipt-publication.test.ts`, `post-close-zero-release-residue.test.ts`, `pre-commit-evidence-context-parity.test.ts`, and `runner-sync-clean-close-pathway.test.ts` all exited 0; `npm run typecheck` and `npm run check:encoding:touched` exited 0. Frozen runner publication commit `96e97ef8642a14567f6c7898025c8c6ce4377c98` was pushed after governed build; the complete missing-argument diagnostic preserves the legacy single-missing receipt error.
followUp: No remaining repair follow-up for this finding. Preserve the runner-sync usage, post-close receipt publication, zero-residue, and evidence-context regressions; any newly reproduced orphan receipt must be recorded as a new incident.
